title.id: Undang-undang yang mengatur penugasan sementara pejabat dan pegawai untuk menjalankan tugas kepala biro serta pejabat atau pegawai lain apabila pejabat yang secara hukum bertanggung jawab sementara tidak hadir atau tidak mampu bertugas

text.en:
In case of the temporary absence or disability of the Secretary of the head of any Office or Bureau
established by law, any official or employee in the Office or Bureau may be designated by the Secretary of
the Department under which the Office or Bureau is established, temporarily to perform the duties of such
head during such absence or disability, and it shall be the duty of the person so designated to perform the
duties of the head of the Office or Bureau without additional compensation. In case the Office or Bureau is
not by law under the charge of the Secretary of any Department, then the designation in this section provided
shall be made by the Civil Governor.

In case of the temporary absence or disability of any subordinate officer or employee in any
Office or Bureau, the head of such Office or Bureau may designate any other subordinate official or
employee in the Office or Bureau temporarily to perform the. duties of the official or employee who is thus
absent or disabled, and it shall be the duty of the person so designated to perform the duties so assigned to
him, without additional compensation.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 28, 1902.
